stem: Which lines from the poem “Maple Street” support the idea that the speaker does not wish to be seen looking at others?

options.label: F
options.text: like I said, there’s his tree. (lines 12–13)

options.label: G
options.text: With my sketchbook and colored pencils, (lines 14–15)

options.label: H
options.text: I can see the whole neighborhood. (lines 30–31)

options.label: J
options.text: hidden by these green and paper leaves, (lines 33–34)
